title: DREAM: Disentangling Risks to Enhance Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for Multimodal Large Language Models, which involves training and evaluating the models on their ability to identify and refuse harmful instructions across several categories. These categories (e.g., violence, illegal activities, discrimination) represent core ethical and moral boundaries. The evaluation prompts and scoring rubrics explicitly reference adherence to 'ethical guidelines'.
